notes: *whether … or* goes whole to the one written אוֹ, headed on the closing connective; neither מִן is what *whether* says, so no morpheme competes for the opening word (rule 14).
The copular frame *he be* joins the first מִן as the prepositional predicate, on the model of rule 20's supplied *it was* in *that it was good* (rules 20, 49).
